title: Open office space
notes: Fixed high overhead time-lapse of a bright open-plan office: ~40 people at long desks with monitors, white tiled floor, potted plants and hanging vines, a blue/yellow abstract mural on the right wall; people sit, stand and walk around fast for the whole clip (no cuts). Fits 'got through today without trouble': a whole ordinary workday passing. Faces are tiny (overhead, time-lapse); a bald man at a monitor in the lower middle is the most visible but still small. Logo: a small white 'LG' on one monitor bezel is visible the whole time (static camera) -> blur_box. Around 5.0 s one laptop screen right of centre briefly shows a green app panel (~[1365,710,1425,750]), tiny and gone in the next frames. Bright daylight: darken and desaturate, push cool.

backup.title: Open office space and staircase
backup.why: Same office seen from the staircase at normal speed, 8.0 s (enough for 6.9 s); bright; colourful mural on the far wall. Check the screens and mural for marks before use.

title: Hands of a man typing on a laptop
notes: Close-up of a man's hands typing on a silver laptop keyboard: right hand sharp in the centre, left hand soft at top left; white shirt cuff and dark grey suit sleeve; warm wooden desk at lower right; shallow depth of field; steady typing for the whole clip. Reads as a generic office worker ('직장인이 다 그렇지'). No face; keys show only generic letters ('caps lock', 'shift'); no brand mark seen. Neutral, slightly warm daylight: cool it down a little. (I switched from 918, a busy open office, because it had several small marks: an LG monitor logo, a 'CHAMPION' T-shirt print and PC-case emblems.)

backup.title: Close-Up of Hands Typing and Using Mouse
backup.why: Close-up of hands typing on a backlit keyboard, then using a mouse; denim-blue shirt sleeve (close to the protagonist's light-blue shirt); 9.2 s. RGB gaming keyboard/mouse look; check for peripheral logos.

title: Sky on a Night to Sunrise Transition
notes: Time-lapse looking up at a starry night sky framed by dark tree branches (top and left). The sky slowly rotates, a mountain silhouette rises at lower left from about 3 s, thin clouds drift in, and a warm dawn glow grows on the lower-right horizon; it is strongest at 7-8.2 s, with tiny town lights at lower left at the end. Fits 'got through the weekdays, and Saturday comes': night turning to dawn leads into P08 (sleeping without an alarm). No people, no text. Cool blue, matches the photos. The best moment is the end, so anchor the clip to end at ~8.1 s: if the slot is shorter, move 'in' later rather than earlier. Note: the tool's get returned only 720p; I fetched the page's 'Full HD' link (1920x1080, 24 fps) through mk.fetch (same lock) and replaced full/100825.mp4.

backup.title: An hourglass and an analog wall clock
backup.why: An hourglass (sand in the top bulb) in front of a blurred analogue wall clock whose second hand sweeps; cool blue-grey; 10.5 s. Shows 'time passing' instead of night to dawn.

title: Woman lying on a sofa
notes: Static wide shot of a bright white living room: a woman (brown hair, red plaid shirt) lies on a tufted beige sofa under a white blanket, lazily clicking a TV remote with a bored face; floor lamp at left, plant at right, small side table with a book and pen. Small movements only; she raises a hand around 17 s. Fits 'the day off feels wasted': lounging away the afternoon. Her face is visible, but she is a woman and can't be mistaken for the protagonist. No logos; the book shows no title. Very bright and white: darken and desaturate strongly, cool it, maybe vignette.

backup.title: Interior of a department room
backup.why: Dim bedroom corner at blue hour: bed with grey and navy pillows, a lit bedside lamp, a tall window with dusk-blue sky, trees and a building; very slight drift; 10.2 s. Gives the 'day slipping away' mood with no person. Same room as st05's 3111.

title: Master bedroom and window
notes: Slow lateral pan across a hotel-style bedroom at blue hour: double bed with grey and navy pillows, two lit bedside lamps, framed blue artwork, and a floor-to-ceiling window at right with dusk-blue sky and trees. Smooth, continuous, no people, no text. Fits the calm opening of 'today we look at two questions and three ways'. Cool and dark, close to the photos; only a slight darken needed.

backup.title: Interior of a department room
backup.why: Same room, closer framing (bed corner, lamp, blue-hour window); 10.2 s, just enough for 9.8 s. Also listed as st04's backup.

title: Office workers hands typing on their devices
notes: Static close shot of an office desk in daylight. Left: a man's hands (navy suit sleeve, white/light-blue cuff) hold a dark tablet with its plain case toward the camera. Right: a woman in a white blouse (neck down) types on a grey laptop, seen side-on. Printed bar and line charts and a pen lie in the foreground; office chairs are blurred behind. Only small hand movements for the whole clip. Fits 'so I don't think I'm short of sleep': ordinary afternoon work going on. It also differs from P14 (typing hands), which comes just before. No faces, no logos seen on the tablet or laptop, chart numbers illegible. Bright: darken and desaturate, cool it, especially for the 3 centre lines.

backup.title: Hands of a girl working on a computer
backup.why: Overhead close-up of a woman's hands (forearm tattoo, red nails) typing on a laptop at a wooden table; 10.2 s, so it needs about 0.78x speed or a second clip to cover 13.0 s.

title: Hourglass in the dark finishes its count
notes: Black background, static camera: a glass hourglass in the left third with sand falling onto a growing pile. A soft light comes up from about 1.0 s, the glass is fully lit about 3.0-10.0 s, then the light fades to black about 11-12.5 s. Low-key, silver monochrome, calm and slow: ideal under all-centre lines. Fits 'scores kept getting worse while sleepiness barely rose': time running, unnoticed. No text. Speed 0.88 stretches source 1.4-11.6 s to 11.6 s on screen; slow sand looks natural. At 1.0x, 1.4-11.6 s gives 10.2 s, which covers est x1.34. The first and last ~0.5 s of the span are dim (natural fade in and out).

backup.title: Glass hourglass close up on a black background
backup.why: Close-up of the hourglass neck on black with sand streaming, cool silver; 10.0 s, so about 0.86x speed for 11.6 s.

title: Silhouette of a man texting during the sunset
notes: Silhouette, side view, of a man with short hair sitting cross-legged on a ledge, head bowed over his phone; behind him a hazy city skyline with the sun low near the horizon and an orange sky. Static; only small thumb and hand movement for the whole clip. Fits 'we should rethink what we mean by "I'm fine"': a reflective figure at dusk over a city, with a phone (a recurring motif). He is a full silhouette with no facial detail, so he could pass as the protagonist. Very warm orange: desaturate hard and shift toward dusk blue/grey to match the cool photos. (A night-office back view, 24063, would have fitted better but is Mixkit Restricted.)

backup.title: New York City View at Night
backup.why: Night skyline of lit towers seen while moving along a suspension bridge (cables cross the frame); very saturated purple/orange, so it needs heavy desaturation; 15.7 s. Weak fallback.

title: Close up shot of a person typing on a laptop
notes: Close-up of hands typing on a silver laptop keyboard: one hand sharp in the centre, the other at top left; the touch strip and screen edge at the top are out of focus. Shallow depth of field, steady typing for the whole clip, neutral cool-grey tone. Under 5/5 centre lines it reads as 'the office worker keeps going' ('직장인은 원래 피곤하지'). No face, no legible text or logo (top strip blurred). Speed 0.95 covers 14.7 s from source 0.1-14.07 s; at 1.0x it gives 14.1 s. Darken for the centre lines. (Tired-worker clips that fit better, 24055 asleep at the desk, 17450 laptop at night and 16215, are all Mixkit Restricted.)

backup.title: New York City View at Night
backup.why: Night city towers from a bridge, calm forward dolly, 15.7 s, enough for 14.7 s; needs heavy desaturation. Also st08's backup.

title: Minimalist room with gray sofa
notes: Slow left-to-right pan across a minimalist living room: grey L-shaped sofa with grey and navy cushions, framed pictures on the wall (abstract painting, small B&W street photo), a bookshelf and blue vase at left; a tall warm floor lamp comes into view at right from about 2.5 s. A black TV with a blank screen and no logo enters at right after about 7.5 s, outside the used span. No people. Fits 'then you might think...': a quiet pause at home before P08's weekend sleep thought. The sofa matches the idea, without a face. Dim, warm lamp light: cool and darken a little.

backup.title: Interior of a department room
backup.why: Bedroom corner with lit lamp and blue-hour window; leads into P08's blue bedroom. Also listed for st04/st05.

title: View from a window of the night outside
notes: Monochrome (black and white) night view through a window: silhouetted tree branches, overhead wires, and a single street light glowing in mist. A dark curtain on the right edge slowly sways in and out, covering more or less of the right third. Static camera, slow, quiet. Fits the centre-line question 'if I sleep more on weekends, won't it even out?': a soft night and sleep mood with calm motion. No people, no text. Already low-saturation and dark; usable as is. (The sibling clip 3977 is in used_before.txt; this is a different clip.)

backup.title: White sand falling inside an hourglass
backup.why: Macro of white sand pouring onto a pile inside an hourglass, grey/black, 10.0 s; an abstract 'balance of time' idea.

title: Glucose molecule
notes: Close-up of a ball-and-stick glucose molecule model (black carbon, red oxygen, white hydrogen) on a white background, slowly drifting and rotating with shallow depth of field, continuous for the whole clip. Literal match for 혈당 (blood glucose) under 'the body's response to insulin, the blood-sugar hormone, dropped'. No people, no text. Very bright white background: darken strongly and cool it so it doesn't flash between the dark photos. (The lab-tube and pipette clip 17497 is Restricted.)

backup.title: Scientist working with blood in a laboratory
backup.why: Young male scientist in goggles, gloves and lab coat using a pipette at a microscope in a bright lab, face visible in profile (lab context, unlikely to be read as the protagonist); 13.3 s.

title: Young woman laying on a white soft bed slowly wakes up in the morning
notes: Top-down close shot of a young woman with long dark hair in striped pyjamas, lying on her side hugging a white pillow, eyes closed. Over the clip she slowly rolls toward the camera onto her back, still dozing, with a faint smile near the end (about 10-14 s). Warm morning light on white bedding with a dark grey blanket. Fits 'weekend catch-up sleep alone did not prevent the changes / that doesn't mean extra weekend sleep is useless': a weekend sleep-in. Calm, slow. Her face is visible (woman, so no protagonist confusion; blurred under 5/5 centre lines), but the brief's idea asked for no face. Every faceless sleep-in or curtain option I found (22240, 22066, 37039, 33550) is Mixkit Restricted. No logos. Warm: desaturate and cool.
